Call submit_output when finished; the files are the submission. Give a summary and your own assessment of completion, checks performed, and remaining work. Hidden checks and reference answers are unavailable. Do not use network access or install packages.

# Task

# Compile a pass-through stage

The workflow compiler already handles delegated sessions and repository
provisioning. Add a built-in `pass_through` stage type to the existing dispatch
architecture. Its configuration is exactly an empty JSON object; reject any
other configuration with a stage-scoped compile error. It materializes as one
scalar unit, releases every declared output immediately, and preserves the
empty configuration in the compiled executor contract. Existing stage types,
custom injected compiler registries, and attention validation must keep their
current behavior.

The public checks are `bun test ./tests/visible` and
`tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`. The evaluator also runs private feature and
regression checks. Keep the implementation within the existing source tree.

## Workspace

The repository is your working directory, `/workspace`. Edit its files in place; the file tree you leave there is your submission. Call `submit_output` with a short summary when you are done.

# Writable scope

Create, modify, or delete files only under these directory prefixes:
- src/compiler/

All other paths are read-only, including visible tests and dependency and configuration files outside the allowed prefixes. An edit outside this scope rejects the submission.

# Budget

900 seconds; at most 60 model requests; at most 8192 output tokens per request.
